cached_specimen_sampling.scope: Actual cached uint16 specimen crop; cubic production interpolation before normalization/zeroguard. Common ROI reference samples the identical local source and zero padding at each policy's actual float32-generated world coordinates. No intensity acceptance tolerance is imposed.

cached_specimen_sampling.method: One-off recorded diagnostic using the production geometry pipeline, both partition policies, download_volume, coordinate_grid and slice_volume_from_grids. Select the first, middle and last changed slice adjacent to either partition boundary. Prefilter one common ROI with scipy.ndimage.spline_filter(order=3, mode=constant), sample it at each production world grid with map_coordinates(prefilter=False, output=float32), and compare separately against an independent float64 world grid. Bin residuals by distance to the nearest assigned integer box face. Original diagnostic script hash retained for provenance; this diagnostic requires the local cached specimen crop and is not the downloadable geometry benchmark.
cached_specimen_sampling.interpretation: The three sampled planes use identical production world coordinates under both policies. Changed crop boundaries produce localized intensity differences before normalization. Residuals remain in the 8–16 voxel band; exact equality beyond 16 voxels in these samples is an observation, not a universal distance guarantee or acceptance tolerance. Normalized full-stack output equivalence was not asserted.
